opinions.text:
Temp. Emerg. Ct. App. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 814.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.

Justice O’Con-nor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
